cell.purpose: Prepare and inspect bounded software-development proposals without automatically granting repository writes, releases, or merges.

face.responsibility: Human-facing Development Board controls and disclosure

memory.responsibility: Frozen specifications and review-only receipt structures

shield.responsibility: Validation rules and non-granting receipt contract

pulse.responsibility: Observed CI and design verification tests

continuity.responsibility: Documented review handoff; full restore not demonstrated

seed.responsibility: Documented reusable trial pattern; self-replication not demonstrated

one_module.note: One bounded capability, but not a self-contained deployable binary.

one_manifest.note: This pilot is one canonical declaration, not yet reused by every runtime.

one_runtime.note: The workflow deliberately uses separate builder and verifier processes.

one_recovery_path.note: No fully qualified single-step restore is available.

local_first.note: Local worker paths exist, but cloud-first manual trials are not fully local.

observable_by_default.note: Actions logs and review receipts exist; complete telemetry is not qualified.

secure_by_default.note: No-write policies and bounded validators exist; no general security attestation.

easy_to_inspect.note: Source and receipt artifacts are available for review.

easy_to_restore.note: A full restoration from one independent backup artifact has not been shown.
